seo.title: Atlaxys Consulting — Software engineering, AI automation & cloud
seo.description: Technology consultancy and engineering studio based in Morocco. We design, build and run web platforms, mobile apps, business software, AI automations and cloud infrastructure.

hero.title: We build the software your business *runs on*.
hero.lead: Atlaxys is an engineering studio based in Morocco, working with companies worldwide. We design the architecture, write the code, automate the busywork — and keep it all running in production.

statement.text: We are consultants who write production code. We sit with you on the problem, draw the architecture, build the product and stay for what comes after launch — monitoring, iteration, the next feature. One team, from the first whiteboard session to the thousandth deploy.

services.title: Four practices. One engineering team.
services.intro: Most projects need more than one of these — that is the point. The people who design your architecture are the people who build it and run it.

process.title: From first question to production. And after.
process.intro: A delivery process designed to surface risk early, while it is still cheap to deal with.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We map the business problem, the users, the constraints and whatever already exists. Before any estimate, we make sure we are solving the right thing.

steps.title: Architect
steps.text: We design the system — data model, integrations, infrastructure — and write down the trade-offs behind every choice, so you can challenge them.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Short iterations with working software every one to two weeks, and a staging environment you can click through from the first sprint.

steps.title: Ship
steps.text: Automated pipelines, uneventful releases, and monitoring and alerting in place before real users arrive.

steps.title: Operate
steps.text: We stay for fixes, improvements, cost reviews and the next roadmap — or hand over cleanly to your team, with documentation they can actually use.

work.title: Problems, worked through.
work.intro: Every case study walks through the challenge, the architecture and the trade-offs — not just the screenshots.

products.title: We also ship our own software.
products.intro: Alongside client work we build and maintain products of our own: ready-made software for specific jobs, held to the same engineering standard.

stack.title: Proven tools, chosen on purpose.
stack.intro: We favour mature, well-supported technology your future team can hire for. Novelty is reserved for the places where it pays for itself.

industries.title: Where our work tends to land.
industries.intro: We are generalist engineers with recurring patterns in a few sectors. If yours is not listed, its underlying problems usually are.

principles.title: What working with us is actually like.

items.title: Architecture before code
items.text: Every project starts with a written design you can read, question and keep. Decisions are documented, not tribal knowledge.

items.title: You own everything
items.text: Source code, cloud accounts, domains and data sit under your organisation from day one. No lock-in, no hostage situations.

items.title: Production is the finish line
items.text: A demo is not a product. We count work as done when it is deployed, monitored and used by real people.

items.title: A direct line to the builders
items.text: You talk to the engineers doing the work, in plain language — English, French or Arabic — not through a chain of account managers.

items.title: Local roots, global hours
items.text: Morocco's time zone overlaps most of the European working day and the North American morning. We work the way international teams expect.

items.question: What does Atlaxys Consulting do?
items.answer: Atlaxys is a technology consulting and software engineering company. We design and build web applications, mobile apps, internal business software, AI-powered automations and cloud infrastructure, and we advise engineering teams on architecture and technical strategy.

items.question: Where is Atlaxys based, and do you work with international clients?
items.answer: We are based in Morocco and work with clients in Morocco and abroad, including Europe, the Middle East, Africa and North America. Most collaboration happens remotely, with on-site workshops when a project calls for them.

items.question: Which languages do you work in?
items.answer: English, French and Arabic. Code and technical documentation are written in English by default, or in the language your team prefers.

items.question: How much does a software project cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope, integrations and how much is still unknown. After a short scoping call we send a written estimate with ranges and the assumptions behind them, so you can see exactly what drives the number.

items.question: Do we own the code and the infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes. Repositories, cloud accounts, domains and data are set up under your organisation. You can continue with us, bring the work in-house or move to another provider at any time.

items.question: Can you take over or modernise an existing system?
items.answer: Yes. We start with a technical audit — code, infrastructure, security and delivery process — then propose a modernisation plan that keeps the business running while the system improves.

cta.title: Have something to build?
cta.text: Tell us what you are working on. An engineer will reply — not a sales sequence.
